html:
UE 5.6 alpha.3 Blender handoff UX

The live Unreal project already contained /Game/ForgeMCP/Returns/SM_Return. The import preflight returned destination_exists to prevent an overwrite.

Alpha.3 explained the collision. A short-lived server 0.3.9 follow-up selected an SM_-prefixed free path and appended suffixes on collisions. That naming policy was superseded by alpha.4 at the user's direction: transferred meshes retain the exact source name, use /Game/Content/Returns/, and report exact-name collisions without silently renaming. See alpha.4 transfer-name acceptance.

The Blender object-name override on Unreal's Send to Blender panel now starts blank. Blank preserves the source Unreal static mesh asset's object name; an entered valid name overrides it. A name collision in Blender remains a preflight failure and can be resolved by entering a different override.

The native panel source is kept in the engine installation, as requested. Before editing it, the alpha.2 header, implementation and descriptor were copied to Engine/Saved/ForgeMCPDevelopmentBackups/TransferPanelFix-20261016-alpha2.

The alpha.3 package is built and validated:

  • The UE 5.6.1 editor-target build compiled 27 actions, including both ForgeMCP modules, in a fresh isolated host. Cargo was disabled for this invocation to avoid its unrelated missing KitBash3dUsdTools dependency.
  • Python source compilation and Ruff passed. The editable MCP package was 0.3.8, and pip check found no broken requirements at alpha.3 installation time.
  • The package loaded in a fresh disposable Blueprint-only project, reported alpha.3 health, matched the packaged DLL hash and exposed the 104-tool source MCP server through real stdio discovery.
  • Archive: Artifacts/ForgeMCP-Unreal-Alpha-0.2.13-alpha.3-UE5.6.1-Win64.zip (SHA-256 200715a0523b92831f7dcd2c99be2c2c5f6e6276d6352034d8c0d2fde29a5ff5).
  • Acceptance record: Saved/UnrealPackageAcceptance-bb6df2aed2ea4627894a6f865cd340f6/acceptance.json.

The engine-wide installer replaced alpha.2 with alpha.3 after the user closed the Editor. Its backup is Engine/Saved/ForgeMCPInstallBackups/cef11a5e92d94a129de2ce8b9176d516/MajesticForge. A fresh disposable project loaded the DLL from the Marketplace engine path; its hash matched the packaged DLL. The acceptance record is Saved/UnrealPackageAcceptance-76f214dc3ff140e5b1f690dd333b1c71/acceptance.json. The user's Blender scene was not changed. ForgeMCPDev was reopened on alpha.3 and its live bridge reported UE 5.6.1, /Game/Levels/TestArea.TestArea, and PIE stopped. A visible panel inspection could not be completed because the Windows Computer Use helper reported its native pipe unavailable; package/build behavior is validated separately from the live widget display.
